subject: Elizabeth line: Royal Oak to Pudding Mill Lane, and Stepney Green to Plumstead Portal (Whitechapel, Canary Wharf, Limmo, Custom House, Thames tunnel, Woolwich)

Westbound is drawn only near Stepney Green Junction. The station boxes, shafts and portals are labelled. We digitised the eastbound crown and invert every 50 m (scratchpad/indoor/tunnels/crossrail-eb-tunnel-digitised.csv, 150 rows; script digitise.py). Axis calibration from the tick marks: 28.34 pt per 10 m vertical, 283.47 pt per 1000 m horizontal. Checks: the crown-invert gap is 7.3-7.6 m everywhere (tunnel external size); the Canary Wharf box is drawn 259 m long (published 260 m); the invert at the box (79.2 mATD) is 2.75 m under the published platform slab 81.95 mATD (Arup paper).
